ruleDefinitions.name: Bypass UAC via CMSTP
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect commandline usage of Microsoft Connection Manager Profile Installer (cmstp.exe) to install specially formatted local .INF files

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmstp\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "CMSTP\.EXE") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/s.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-s.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/au.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-au.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/ni.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-ni.*")))
